an-old-north-american-potash-feldspar-er: Tsohon potash feldspar na Arewacin Amurka, mai yawan silica, wanda ake samu a littattafan Amurka kaɗai; wani girke-girke na Glazy da aka ɗauko daga Chinese Stoneware Glazes na Grebanier yana neman ''Godfrey or Maine feldspar''. warning-seaforth-mineral-ore-sds-acid-1e: Gargaɗi (Seaforth Mineral & Ore SDS, acid grade): zai iya cutarwa idan an haɗiye ko an shaƙa, kuma zai iya sa ƙaiƙayin fata, ido da hanyoyin numfashi; crystalline silica 0.09–2.8%; yana fitar da fluorine yayin gasa.

potash-feldspar-from-spain-made-by-1192t: Potash feldspar daga Spain, wanda ake samarwa ta hanyar flotation daga yashi mai feldspar, kuma Imerys ke shigo da shi a matsayin madadin G-200 bayan an rufe ma’adinin Georgia. Takardar bayanin ta ce K-feldspar 70%, Na-feldspar 23% da quartz 7%.

contains-crystalline-silica-about-10-qua: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (kusan quartz 10% bisa SDS); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
silica-deficient-sodium-potassium-alumin: Sodium-potassium aluminosilicate mai ƙarancin silica (albite, microcline da nepheline) daga Ontario, flux mafi ƙarfi fiye da soda feldspar. lithium-aluminosilicate-with-very-low-th: Lithium aluminosilicate mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa saboda zafi sosai, ana amfani da shi wajen yaƙi da crazing da fashewa saboda sauyin zafi. Ba ya sa ruwan glaze ya yi kumfa kamar yadda wasu spodumene ke yi.
natural-calcium-silicate-the-wollastonit: Calcium silicate na halitta, wollastonite ɗin da yawancin masu sayar da kayan tukwane a Amurka ke sayarwa (Laguna, Seattle Pottery Supply da Bailey suna ajiye nau’ukan Vansil). needle-shaped-acicular-mineral-dust-avoi: Ƙurar ma’adini mai siffar allura (acicular); ku guji shaƙarta.
high-purity-new-york-wollastonite-with-1: Wollastonite na New York mai tsafta sosai, mai ƙaramin LOI. Imerys yana tallata nau’ukan NYAD M200, M325 da M400 don jikin yumɓu da glaze; Sheffield Pottery yana sayar da NYAD-G.
a-cornwall-stone-replacement-from-hammil: Madadin Cornwall stone daga Hammill & Gillespie, wanda yawanci ya ƙunshi kusan quartz 20%, albite 52% da orthoclase 27%. Ba kamar ainihin Cornish stone ba, wanda ba a haƙo shi ba tun 2006, ba shi da fluorine.
contains-crystalline-silica-about-20-qua: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (kusan quartz 20%); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.

contains-crystalline-silica-10-25-quartz: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (quartz 10-25% bisa SDS na Laguna na 2024); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
indian-potash-feldspar-from-imerys-impor: Potash feldspar na Indiya daga Imerys, wanda Hammill & Gillespie ke shigo da shi tun kusan 2024 a matsayin wani madadin G-200 da Custer. Sinadaransa suna kusa da na G-200 EU.
the-standard-us-potash-feldspar-for-saiz: Potash feldspar na Amurka da aka saba amfani da shi shekaru da dama, wanda ake haɗawa a Monticello, Georgia, daga kusan G-200 HP mai yawan potash 70% da Minspar 200 soda feldspar 30%. Ku yi amfani da G-200 EU ko Mahavir don tsofaffin girke-girke.
high-potash-feldspar-that-laguna-sold-1a: Feldspar mai yawan potash wanda Laguna ya sayar da sunan ''G-200 New Potash'' bayan asalin haɗin G-200 ya ƙare. Laguna ya kuma sayar da haɗin Minspar 200 : G-200 HP na 3:7 da sunan ''G200 Old Blend'' don ya yi daidai da tsoffin sinadaran.
a-popular-north-american-soda-feldspar-1: Shahararren soda feldspar na Arewacin Amurka wanda ba a yin sa yanzu; Minspar 200 yana da sinadarai masu kama da shi sosai kuma shi ne madadin da aka saba.
a-fluorine-bearing-lithium-potassium-mic: Lithium-potassium mica mai ɗauke da fluorine, wanda magina na Amurka ba su samu ba tun da daɗewa. Babu madadin kai tsaye; ku samo Li2O daga spodumene, petalite ko lithium carbonate, K2O kuma daga potash feldspar.
jeff-zamek-s-1997-guide-to-plkif7: Jagorar Jeff Zamek ta 1997 game da musanya a Ceramics Monthly ta riga ta ce an daina yin sa.
contains-fluorine-which-is-released-as-1: Yana ƙunshe da fluorine, wanda ke fita a matsayin hayaƙi yayin gasa kuma zai iya sa kumfa da ramuka a glaze; ku ba kiln iska.
a-water-washed-secondary-kaolin-from-1i5: Secondary kaolin da aka wanke da ruwa daga Edgar, Florida, wanda ya daɗe shi ne kaolin na glaze da aka saba amfani da shi a Amurka domin yana riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa da kyau kuma yana fitowa fari bayan gasa. contains-crystalline-silica-quartz-do-no: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (quartz); kada ku shaƙi ƙurar.
a-white-firing-georgia-kaolin-that-1k8rp: Kaolin na Georgia mai fitowa fari bayan gasa wanda masu sayarwa na Amurka yanzu ke ajiyewa a madadin EPK. an-air-floated-georgia-kaolin-and-1f3wll: Kaolin na Georgia da aka tace da iska, kuma kaolin mafi laushin aiki (plastic) da ake sayarwa a Arewacin Amurka. Yana taimakawa riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa amma ba thixotropic ba ne kamar EPK, kuma TiO2 ɗinsa (1.4%) yana sa ya fito ƙasa da fari fiye da EPK.
a-fine-plastic-kentucky-ball-clay-1l3mfw: Ball clay na Kentucky mai laushi da laushin aiki, ''ball clay'' da aka saba amfani da shi a Amurka a girke-girken glaze da na jikin yumɓu. a-325-mesh-calcined-kaolin-made-843pbe: Calcined kaolin na 325-mesh da aka yi don fenti, kuma masu sayar da kayan tukwane na Amurka suke sayarwa a matsayin calcined kaolin ɗinsu. kaolin-fired-to-drive-off-its-47owxv: Kaolin da aka gasa don fitar da ruwan sinadaransa, mai sinadarai iri ɗaya da na kaolin ban da LOI. Girke-girken da ke lissafa ''calcined kaolin'' kawai za su iya amfani da wannan.
a-red-burning-iron-rich-ohio-91msbo: Yumɓun earthenware na Ohio mai yawan iron wanda ke fitowa ja bayan gasa, an tace shi da iska zuwa 200 mesh. A glaze tushen iron ne (kusan Fe2O3 7%) da alkali, ana amfani da shi har zuwa 60% a wasu glaze masu launin ruwan ƙasa da irin na slip.
a-plastic-cream-burning-southern-ohio-d7: Yumɓun stoneware na kudancin Ohio mai laushin aiki wanda ke fitowa launin kirim bayan gasa, an tace shi da iska zuwa 200 mesh. Galibi yumɓun jiki ne; a glaze yana bayar da alumina da silica tare da wani adadin iron da titanium.
contains-crystalline-silica-quartz-do-no: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (quartz); kada ku shaƙi ƙurar. Yana ƙunshe da wani adadin sulfur.
a-plastic-buff-firing-missouri-fireclay-: Fireclay na Missouri mai laushin aiki wanda ke fitowa launin ruwan ƙasa mai haske bayan gasa, ana sayar da shi a niƙan 20, 35, 40 da 50 mesh. Galibi yumɓun jiki ne; ƙimomin na yau da kullum ne ga yumɓu na halitta.
a-blended-iron-bearing-slip-clay-1wfl7qj: Slip clay mai ɗauke da iron da aka haɗa, wanda Plainsman ke yi tun 1988 a matsayin madadin Albany slip. Shi kaɗai yana narkewa ya zama launin ruwan ƙasa mai sheƙi a cone 10 (tenmoku a reduction) kuma yana buƙatar kusan frit 20% a cone 6; ku yi amfani da haɗin gasasshe da ɗanye a girke-girke masu yawan kashi don guje wa tsagewa yayin bushewa.
a-silty-iron-rich-new-york-oucatm: Yumɓun New York mai laka da yawan iron wanda shi kaɗai yake narkewa ya zama glaze mai duhun launin ruwan ƙasa mai sheƙi a cone 8 zuwa 10, kuma yana cikin dubban tsofaffin girke-girke. Ba a samar da shi ba tun ƙarshen shekarun 1980; ku yi amfani da Alberta Slip a madadinsa.
leadless-low-alumina-calcium-sodium-boro: Calcium-sodium borosilicate frit marar darma (lead), mai ƙarancin alumina; frit da aka fi amfani da shi a girke-girken glaze na Arewacin Amurka, galibi a matsayin tushen boron da calcium. Fusion 1450 F, flow 1600 F, CTE 9.47 (Ferro 2008).
non-hazardous-glass-powder-per-supplier-: Garin gilashi marar haɗari bisa SDS na mai sayarwa; ku guji shaƙar ƙura.
calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-a-balance: Calcium borosilicate frit mai daidaitattun sinadarai kamar na glaze (yana ƙunshe da kusan alumina 10%); tare da ɗan kaolin kusan cikakken glaze ne na ƙaramin zafi. Fusion 1600 F, flow 1750 F, CTE 7.94 (Ferro 2008).
high-sodium-low-boron-high-expansion-ggm: Frit mai yawan sodium, ƙarancin boron da babban faɗaɗawa; tushen soda da aka saba a kowane zafi da kuma a crystalline glaze. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 10.08 (Ferro 2008).
well-balanced-high-boron-calcium-borosil: Calcium borosilicate frit mai daidaito da yawan boron; kusan frit 85 da kaolin 15 suna yin glaze mai haske na cone 04. Fusion 1500 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 7.16 (Ferro 2008).
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit marar alkali mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa saboda zafi sosai (CTE kusan 4.0); ana amfani da shi a 3-10% don magance crazing kuma a matsayin tushen MgO mai narkewa a ƙaramin zafi. Fusion 1900 F, flow 2300 F (Ferro 2003).
high-alkali-almost-calcium-free-alkali-3: Alkali borosilicate frit mai yawan alkali kuma kusan marar calcium, tare da ɗan zinc da fluorine; babban faɗaɗawa, ana amfani da shi don glaze na crackle da na launukan alkaline. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1500 F, CTE 9.98 (Ferro 2008).
contains-about-1-5-fluorine-which-q7b1ho: Yana ƙunshe da kusan fluorine 1.5%, wanda zai iya fita yayin gasa; ku ba kiln iska. Ban da haka, garin gilashi ne mai ƙaramin haɗari.
artware-flux-calcium-borosilicate-frit-f: Calcium borosilicate frit na flux don kayan fasaha; Fusion ya lissafa shi a matsayin daidai da Vibrantz 3134. Idan aka kwatanta da 3134-2 (Ferro 2008): Al2O3 -1.20, B2O3 +1.01, SiO2 -0.56, CaO +0.49, Na2O +0.26 maki; yana narkewa ya ɗan fi gudana.
boro-calcium-dinnerware-frit-fusion-s-lb: Boro-calcium frit na kwanonin abinci; Fusion ya lissafa shi a matsayin daidai da Vibrantz 3124. Idan aka kwatanta da 3124-2 (Ferro 2008): B2O3 +0.86, K2O -0.68 (babu a F-19), Na2O +0.60, SiO2 -0.44, Al2O3 -0.31 maki; yana ɗan fi gudana.
high-calcium-boron-leadless-frit-fusion-: Boron frit marar darma (lead) mai yawan calcium; Fusion ya lissafa shi a matsayin daidai da Vibrantz 3195. Shi ne mafi nisa a cikin waɗannan kamanni: idan aka kwatanta da 3195-2 (Ferro 2008) yana da K2O +3.70, Na2O -2.69, B2O3 -2.32, Al2O3 +1.52, CaO -0.86, SiO2 +0.65 maki.
high-sodium-low-boron-frit-fusion-16l28b: Frit mai yawan sodium da ƙarancin boron; Fusion ya lissafa shi a matsayin daidai da Vibrantz 3110, kuma shi ne mafi kusa a cikin waɗannan kamanni: kowane oxide bai wuce maki 0.26 ba daga 3110-2 (Ferro 2008). Yana ɗan fi gudana kuma ƙarfin fuskarsa (surface tension) ya fi ƙaranci.
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: Magnesia borosilicate frit marar alkali mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa sosai (CTE 3.96), ana amfani da shi don yaƙi da crazing; Fusion ya lissafa shi a matsayin daidai da Vibrantz 3249. Idan aka kwatanta da 3249 ba shi da CaO (-3.50 maki), SiO2 +2.40, B2O3 +1.30, Al2O3 -0.80, MgO +0.60.
natural-sodium-calcium-borate-ore-colema: Ɗanyen ma’adinin sodium-calcium borate na halitta (colemanite da ulexite tare da yumɓu mai kama da hectorite), wanda ya daɗe shi ne babban boron flux na ƙarami da matsakaicin zafi a girke-girken Amurka. An rufe ma’adinin a 2000; sauran kayan da suka rage kaɗan ne kuma suna da tsada, kuma Gillespie Borate ne madadin da ake ba da shawara, fam da fam.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-kpnwt9: Borate: kada ku haɗiye shi; binciken dabbobi da aka ba yawan inorganic borates ya nuna illa ga haihuwa/girma (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Ku guji shaƙar ƙura. Mai sayarwa yana ɗauke da gargaɗin California Prop 65 game da crystalline silica.
blended-borate-mainly-ulexite-with-some-: Borate da aka haɗa (galibi ulexite tare da wani adadin colemanite da kusan 10% na abu mai kama da yumɓu) wanda aka yi a matsayin madadin Gerstley Borate fam da fam; ana samar da shi kuma ana sayar da shi yanzu a Amurka, UK da Turai.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-havqf3: Borate: kada ku haɗiye shi; binciken dabbobi da aka ba yawan inorganic borates ya nuna illa ga haihuwa/girma (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Ku guji shaƙar ƙura.
legacy-blended-gerstley-borate-substitut: Tsohon madadin Gerstley Borate da aka haɗa wanda Laguna ya sayar a shekarun 2000; ku ajiye shi don tsofaffin girke-girke kaɗai. Yana buƙatar bentonite ko hectorite kashi 6-8 cikin 100 don ya riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa kamar Gerstley Borate; Gillespie Borate ne madadin na yanzu.
laguna-withdrew-it-in-2012-its-13jz0u3: Laguna ya janye shi a 2012: an maye gurbin takardar bayanan aminci tasa a watan Mayu na wannan shekarar da sanarwar cewa, da yake Gerstley Borate ya sake yawaita, Laguna Borate ba ya samuwa.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-13mdgfk: Borate: kada ku haɗiye shi; binciken dabbobi da aka ba yawan inorganic borates ya nuna illa ga haihuwa/girma (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Ku guji shaƙar ƙura. MSDS na Laguna ya lissafa crystalline silica da calcium carbonate.
legacy-plastic-gerstley-borate-substitut: Tsohon madadin Gerstley Borate mai laushin aiki wanda Plainsman Clays ya ƙirƙira a 2000 kuma aka sayar a farkon shekarun 2000; ba a yin sa yanzu. Ku ajiye shi don tsofaffin girke-girke kaɗai; Gillespie Borate ne madadin na yanzu.
plainsman-s-materials-page-listed-it-388: Shafin kayan Plainsman ya lissafa shi har ƙarshen 2017, kuma a Janairu 2018 ba ya nan.
commercial-turkish-sodium-calcium-borate: Ɗanyen ma’adinin sodium-calcium borate na kasuwa daga Turkiyya, ana sayar da shi a niƙe (nau’ukan micron 75 da 45); tushen boron ne ɗanye da magina na Turai da Rasha suka fi amfani da shi, da kuma a madadin Gerstley Borate da ake haɗawa a gida. Yana narkewa kaɗan a ruwa kuma yana rasa kusan kashi ɗaya cikin uku na nauyinsa yayin gasa.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-1q1jdvy: Borate: kada ku haɗiye shi; binciken dabbobi da aka ba yawan inorganic borates ya nuna illa ga haihuwa/girma (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Ku guji shaƙar ƙura. SDS na Etimine (rev. Oct 2021) ya ce ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba a ƙarƙashin UN GHS.
aluminum-hydroxide-powder-used-to-add-8q: Garin aluminum hydroxide da ake amfani da shi don ƙara alumina a glaze, da kuma a kiln wash da wadding; yana riƙuwa a cikin ruwa kuma yana manne fiye da calcined alumina. Yana rasa kusan 35% na nauyinsa a matsayin ruwa kusan 220-300 C.
low-hazard-avoid-breathing-dust-18o1ah: Ƙaramin haɗari; ku guji shaƙar ƙura.
calcined-aluminum-oxide-ground-to-325-43: Calcined aluminum oxide da aka niƙa zuwa -325 mesh; yana jure zafi sosai (yana narkewa kusan 2040 C), ana amfani da shi don sa glaze ya zama marar sheƙi da kuma ƙara masa tauri, da kuma a kiln wash. Nau’uka masu laushi sosai ne kaɗai suke narkewa gaba ɗaya a glaze.
low-hazard-nuisance-dust-avoid-breathing: Ƙura mai damuwa mai ƙaramin haɗari; ku guji shaƙarta.
blended-cornish-china-clay-from-imerys-6: Cornish china clay da aka haɗa daga Imerys mai ƙarancin titania sosai da kusan K2O 2%, don haka yana fitowa fari mai ɗan shuɗi bayan gasa. Shi ne kaolin da aka saba a jikin porcelain na UK da yawancin girke-girken glaze na UK.
fine-dust-may-contain-traces-of-1caabb5: Ƙura mai laushi; tana iya ƙunsar ɗan crystalline silica.
imerys-cornish-china-clay-with-more-1xib: Cornish china clay na Imerys mai ƙarin laushin aiki da ɗan ƙarancin iron da potash fiye da Grolleg; yana fitowa fari sosai bayan gasa. An yi shi don jikin porcelain, kuma ana amfani da shi a glaze kamar kowane kaolin.
imerys-calcined-cornish-china-clay-about: Calcined Cornish china clay na Imerys (kusan mullite 55%, gilashi 45%). Nau’uka masu laushi suna maye gurbin wani sashi na ɗanyen yumɓu a glaze masu yawan yumɓu don rage raguwa da crawling, kuma suna ɗan ɗaga zafin da glaze ke kammala narkewa (maturing temperature).
high-silica-devon-ball-clay-with-all38y: Ball clay na Devon mai yawan silica, mai kyakkyawan laushin aiki, matsakaicin ƙarfi da ƙarancin iron; yana fitowa launin hauren giwa mai haske bayan gasa. Ball clay da aka saba a glaze da slip na UK.
dorset-ball-clay-with-high-strength-cu8i: Ball clay na Dorset mai ƙarfi sosai da iron mai ɗan yawa (kusan Fe2O3 2.3%), ana amfani da shi a jikin stoneware masu launi mai dumi da wasu glaze da slip na UK.
low-plasticity-white-firing-ball-clay-2z: Ball clay mai ƙarancin laushin aiki wanda ke fitowa fari bayan gasa, Potclays ke sayarwa, sananne a jikin stoneware; ya fi TWVA fitowa fari.
blend-of-medium-plasticity-white-firing-: Haɗin ball clay masu matsakaicin laushin aiki da ke fitowa fari bayan gasa. Potclays yana sayar da shi a matsayin madadin ESVA ball clay, wanda masu samarwa suka daina yi.
potclays-potash-feldspar-almost-no-soda-: Potash feldspar na Potclays: kusan babu soda kuma yana da ƙarin free silica, don haka alumina ɗinsa ya fi ƙaranci fiye da yawancin potash feldspar. Ƙimomin tsakiyar iyakokin da aka wallafa ne.
long-standing-uk-catalogue-figures-for-q: Ƙimomin potash feldspar na daɗe a kundin kayan UK, waɗanda Potterycrafts, Bath Potters da CTM suka buga. Bath Potters ya ce potash feldspar ɗinsa na Norway ne.
potterycrafts-data-sheet-for-p3296-octob: Takardar bayanin Potterycrafts ta P3296 (Oktoba 2025) ta ba da binciken Norflux K 11 na Sibelco maimakon haka (K₂O 11.8, Na₂O 2.9), don haka kayan da yake da su yanzu na iya zama wannan feldspar: duba Norflux Potash Feldspar.
valentine-clays-potash-feldspar-a-typica: Potash feldspar na Valentine Clays, potash feldspar na yau da kullum mai kusan K2O 10.4% da Na2O 2.3%.
spanish-sodium-feldspar-albite-with-almo: Sodium feldspar na Spain (albite) kusan marar potash, wanda Potclays, Potterycrafts da Valentine ke sayarwa da bincike iri ɗaya. Flux ne mafi ƙarfi kuma mai narkewa a ƙaramin zafi fiye da potash feldspar.
the-soda-feldspar-figures-printed-by-pm7: Ƙimomin soda feldspar da Bath Potters da CTM suka buga; Bath Potters ya ce na Norway ne.
mixed-potash-soda-feldspar-about-7-uyikr: Potash-soda feldspar gauraye (kusan K2O 7%, Na2O 5%) daga masana’antar flotation ta Sibelco a Finland. Wannan shi ne ''FFF'' da Potclays, Potterycrafts, Valentine da CTM ke sayarwa; sunan yana nufin Finnish Flotation Feldspar.
finnish-feldspar-quartz-pegmatite-that-p: Feldspar-quartz pegmatite na Finland wanda Potclays ke sayarwa a matsayin madadin Forshammar feldspar da yanzu ba a samu. Yawan silica ɗinsa yana sa ya yi aiki kamar Cornish stone fiye da ainihin feldspar.
the-nepheline-syenite-sold-in-the-1x77jq: Nepheline syenite da ake sayarwa a UK na Norway ne, mai K2O da Na2O kusan daidai. Girke-girken Amurka suna ɗauka cewa A270 ne na Canada (K2O 4.8, Na2O 10.5), don haka ba za a iya musanya su ba sai an sake lissafi.
fine-dust-low-in-free-silica-1tgmsj5: Ƙura mai laushi; free silica ɗinta kaɗan ne amma ku guji shaƙarta.
natural-cornish-stone-is-no-longer-1o4yc: Ba a haƙo Cornish stone na halitta yanzu, don haka masu sayarwa na UK yanzu suna sayar da madadi. FCS2 na Valentine ''a milled material composite flux designed to match the firing characteristics of Cornish Stone'' ne (flux da aka niƙa aka haɗa don ya yi daidai da yadda Cornish Stone ke gasuwa); yana narkewa a 1100-1300 °C.
the-leadless-frit-most-used-in-r48r5w: Frit marar darma (lead) da aka fi amfani da shi a glaze na earthenware na UK: calcium borosilicate mai kusan B2O3 19%. Iyakar gasa 900-1050 °C (Bath Potters) ko 950-1150 °C (Potclays).
not-classified-ctm-standard-borax-frit-1: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM Standard Borax Frit SDS 36, wanda aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin daidai da shi); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
potterycrafts-standard-borax-frit-a-gene: Standard borax frit na Potterycrafts, frit marar darma (lead) na amfanin gama gari don glaze na earthenware. Faɗaɗawa 8.3 x 10^-6/°C, iyakar gasa 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2953-u: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Potterycrafts SDS P2953; quartz ƙasa da 1%); shaƙar ƙurar na dogon lokaci yana ƙara haɗarin cutar huhu.
soft-fluid-high-expansion-alkaline-frit-: Alkaline frit mai laushi, mai gudana kuma mai babban faɗaɗawa don glaze na crackle da raku da shuɗin copper na alkaline. Faɗaɗawa 13.4 x 10^-6/°C, iyakar gasa 880-1060 °C.
contains-barium-about-7-bao-soluble-1xab: Yana ƙunshe da barium (kusan BaO 7%); alkaline frit mai narkewa a ruwa, ku guji haɗiye shi.
newer-uk-high-alkaline-frit-with-1swirl0: Sabon high alkaline frit na UK mai soda da potash kusan daidai (kusan 17% kowanne) kuma babu barium; don glaze na crackle da shuɗin copper. Iyakar gasa 860-1060 °C.
very-soluble-alkaline-frit-avoid-ingesti: Alkaline frit mai narkewa a ruwa sosai; ku guji haɗiye shi.
sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-about-25-a: Sodium borosilicate frit mai kusan B2O3 25% kuma kusan babu lime, ana ba da shawararsa don glaze na turquoise na copper. Faɗaɗawa 6.9 x 10^-6/°C, iyakar gasa 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2961-b: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Potterycrafts SDS P2961); shaƙar ƙurar na dogon lokaci yana ƙara haɗarin cutar huhu.
uk-fritted-calcium-borate-used-in-nlgcqo: Calcium borate da aka mayar frit na UK, ana amfani da shi a madadin colemanite ko Gerstley borate (kusan B2O3 50%, CaO 26.5%). Faɗaɗawa 6.1 x 10^-6/°C, iyakar gasa 1050-1160 °C. Akwai shi a Potterycrafts a Oktoba 2026.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2954-b: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Potterycrafts SDS P2954); shaƙar ƙurar na dogon lokaci yana ƙara haɗarin cutar huhu.
potclays-calcium-borate-frit-long-establ: Calcium borate frit na Potclays, ''long established as the substitute for colemanite in glazes'' (wanda ya daɗe a matsayin madadin colemanite a glaze). Frit ne mai ɗanshi da ƙwaya-ƙwaya; iyakar gasa 800-1100 °C, ba don gasa da sauri ba.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (SDS na Potterycrafts P2954 mai kama da shi; takardar calcium borate frit ta Bath Potters ta ce ba a buƙatar alamar haɗari); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
ctm-s-calcium-borate-frit-on-1ttusd1: Calcium borate frit na CTM, wanda ake sayarwa har aƙalla 2019 kuma ''not available'' (ba a samu) a Disamba 2025. Binciken shi ne wanda jerin farashin CTM suka buga daga 2016 zuwa 2026 (iri ɗaya da Potterycrafts P2954); shafin frit na CTM a yanar gizo yana ba da wani tsoho (SiO₂ 24, Al₂O₃ 8, B₂O₃ 41, CaO 22). CTM ya ba da shawara, ga kowane 100 g da aka cire daga girke-girke: ku ƙara Gillespie Borate 167 g da quartz 10 g, ku cire whiting 12 g da potash feldspar 26 g, sannan ku gwada.
not-classified-ctm-sds-37-avoid-o1fm3n: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM SDS 37); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
leadless-low-expansion-frit-small-additi: Frit marar darma (lead) mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa; ƙara kaɗan nasa yana ƙara juriyar glaze ga crazing, yawansa kuma yana ba da launin madara. Iyakar gasa 1020-1150 °C (Bath Potters) ko 1040-1100 °C (Potclays). Takardar Potclays, da Bath Potters a bayanta, ta buga Li₂O 0.10, wanda ke barin binciken a 99.0%. Tsarin sinadarai na Potclays kansa a takardar guda (0.176 Li₂O) yana ba da 1.06%, kamar yadda Potterycrafts P2960 mai kusan kama da shi ke yi, don haka an yi amfani da 1.1.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (SDS na Potterycrafts P2960 mai kama da shi); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
low-expansion-borax-frit-used-to-1bguah0: Borax frit mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa da ake amfani da shi don rage faɗaɗawar glaze inda crazing matsala ce; idan ya wuce kusan 5% zai iya sa fuskar ta dushe. Faɗaɗawa 3.8 x 10^-6/°C, iyakar gasa 1020-1150 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2960-b: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Potterycrafts SDS P2960); shaƙar ƙurar na dogon lokaci yana ƙara haɗarin cutar huhu.
a-true-lead-bisilicate-65-66-1ics0hr: ''Ainihin'' lead bisilicate na darma (lead, Pb) (PbO 65-66%, SiO2 32%, Al2O3 2%) wanda har yanzu ake sayarwa a UK a matsayin frit da aka saba don glaze na earthenware masu ƙarancin narkewa (low-solubility); gasa 880-1050 °C (Potclays).
lead-frit-toxic-if-the-dust-1fnhzt2: Frit na darma (lead, Pb): mai guba ne idan an shaƙi ƙurar ko an haɗiye ta. higher-lead-frit-1-pbo-to-1je72om: Frit mai yawan darma (lead, Pb) (1 PbO zuwa 1.5 SiO2) da Potclays da Bath Potters ke sayarwa ''for artistic glazes where food safety is not required'' (don glaze na fasaha inda ba a buƙatar lafiya ga abinci). Iyakar gasa 860-1040 °C (Potclays).
lead-frit-toxic-if-the-dust-foqu21: Frit na darma (lead, Pb): mai guba ne idan an shaƙi ƙurar ko an haɗiye ta. Glaze da aka gasa zai iya sakin darma (Pb) cikin abinci da abin sha; masu sayarwa na UK sun ce glaze masu ƙarancin narkewa ba su da lafiya ga abinci a asali, kuma dole a gwada kayan don sakin ƙarfe. Ana sayar da shi a fili a matsayin wanda ba don kayan da ke taɓa abinci ba.
uk-flint-is-calcined-flint-pebble-6yaur1: ''Flint'' na UK tsakuwar flint ce da aka gasa, ba quartz da aka niƙa ba: kusan SiO2 96% tare da CaO 1.3% da LOI 1.3%. Valentine ya ce yana ɗaga faɗaɗawa saboda zafi idan aka ƙara shi a glaze. Girke-girken Amurka da suka ce ''flint'' suna nufin quartz da aka niƙa.
respirable-crystalline-silica-including-: Crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa, har da wani adadin cristobalite; ku yi amfani da respirator (abin rufe fuska mai tace iska) da ya dace.
the-potash-feldspar-that-most-german-mhg: Potash feldspar da yawancin masu sayar da kayan tukwane na Jamus ke sayarwa (BSZ, Carl Jäger, Keramik-Kraft, Töpferbedarf Rantzau), wanda Lehmhuus (Switzerland), keramik.at (Austria) da Solargil (France) ma suke sayarwa. BSZ ya ce kusan potash feldspar 72% ne, soda feldspar 23% da quartz 2%.
potterycrafts-p3296-data-sheet-october-2: Takardar bayanin Potterycrafts ta P3296 (Oktoba 2025) ta ba da wannan binciken, don haka da alama ana sayar da shi a UK a matsayin P3296.
sibelco-s-safety-data-sheet-2024-hx53ln: Takardar bayanan aminci ta Sibelco (2024-03) ba ta sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba, kuma ta ce quartz mai laushi ƙasa da 1% ne, tare da nepheline syenite har zuwa 25% a cikin haɗin. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
albite-soda-feldspar-from-sibelco-s-d39b: Albite soda feldspar daga kayan Sibelco na Jamus, wanda Carl Jäger da BSZ ke sayarwa da sunan ''Feldspat Na LF 90'', Keramik-Kraft kuma da sunan ''Natron (Maxum/LA75)''. Kusan albite ne zalla, don haka yana narkewa da wuri fiye da Norflux potash feldspar.
carl-ja-ger-s-safety-data-szccqx: Takardar bayanan aminci ta Carl Jäger (2012) ta ce quartz 1-3%; ƙurar na iya ƙunsar crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa. Ku guji shaƙarta.
potash-feldspar-sold-by-the-swiss-1jyw5l: Potash feldspar da mai sayar da kayan tukwane na Switzerland Bodmer Ton ke sayarwa, mai kusan K2O 10.7% da Na2O 3%. Bodmer ya ce yana narkewa a 1250 °C.
soda-feldspar-mainly-albite-with-a-usgao: Soda feldspar (galibi albite) tare da ɗan ƙarin quartz, wanda Bodmer Ton ke sayarwa a Switzerland. Bodmer ya ce yana narkewa a 1180 °C.
bodmer-labels-it-ghs08-health-hazard-yp1: Bodmer ya sa masa alamar GHS08 (haɗari ga lafiya) domin ƙurar tana ƙunshe da crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa; ku guji shaƙarta.
spanish-potash-feldspar-from-imerys-s-1v: Potash feldspar na Spain daga masana’antar Imerys a Onda, wanda wasu masu sayar da kayan tukwane na France ke sayarwa (Ceradel, Solargil, Céram-Décor). Sinadaransa suna kusa da na G-200 EU, wanda Imerys ke yi a masana’antar guda don kasuwar Amurka.
imerys-s-safety-data-sheet-2013-15ms3kd: Takardar bayanan aminci ta Imerys (2013) ba ta sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba, kuma ta ce quartz da ake iya shaƙa ƙasa da 1% ne; ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
very-white-potash-feldspar-mostly-orthoc: Potash feldspar fari sosai, galibi orthoclase, wanda mai sayarwa na France Ceradel ke sayarwa; kusan 5% yana tsayawa a kan rariya ta 44 µm.
a-blend-of-feldspars-with-more-1l53rzf: Haɗin feldspar mai soda (6.9%) fiye da potash (4.3%), wanda Ceradel ke sayarwa. Yana tsakanin soda da potash feldspar a yadda yake narkewa.
spanish-soda-feldspar-sold-to-potters-uj: Soda feldspar na Spain da Prodesco ke sayar wa magina, da shagunan da ke ajiye kayansa (Marphil, Kádar), a France kuma Solargil da sunan ''Feldspath sodique FN72''. Prodesco ya ce albite 61% ne, orthoclase 7%, anorthite 8% da quartz 24%, don haka yana ɗauke da free silica mai yawa.
about-24-quartz-by-the-supplier-da180d: Kusan quartz 24% bisa binciken ma’adinai na mai sayarwa, don haka ƙurar tana ƙunshe da crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa; ku guji shaƙarta.
the-potash-feldspar-of-spain-s-7emvi0: Potash feldspar na babbar alamar kayan tukwane ta Spain. Duk da sunansa, K2O 7.5% kaɗai yake ɗauke da shi tare da Na2O 3.75% da ƙarin silica, don haka flux ne mafi rauni fiye da ainihin potash feldspar.
a-sodic-pegmatite-soda-feldspar-with-llp: Sodic pegmatite: soda feldspar mai quartz mai yawa, wanda ake sayar wa magina na Spain. Flux ne mai tauri kuma mai yawan silica fiye da soda feldspar, ana amfani da shi kaɗan kamar Cornish stone.
high-in-free-quartz-about-75-1feyvbz: Yana da yawan free quartz (kusan SiO2 75% gaba ɗaya); ƙurar tana ƙunshe da crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa. Ku guji shaƙarta.
a-very-pure-potash-feldspar-86-zztdw5: Potash feldspar mai tsafta sosai (potash feldspar 86%, soda feldspar 7%, quartz 5% bisa binciken ma’adinai na mai sayarwa), mai K2O 14.5% da Na2O ƙasa da 1%, kusa da orthoclase na ka’ida. Sila Argille ke sayar wa magina a Italiya.
swedish-feldspar-quartz-rock-from-sibelc: Dutsen feldspar-quartz na Sweden daga ma’adinin Forshammar na Sibelco, mai soda da potash kusan daidai da free silica mai yawa. Ana ambaton Forshammar feldspar a yawancin tsofaffin girke-girken stoneware na Sweden, amma masu sayar da kayan tukwane na Sweden da UK yanzu suna sayar da FFF ko FFP 45 na Finland a madadinsa.
high-in-free-quartz-sio2-about-1h1npth: Yana da yawan free quartz (SiO2 kusan 76%); ƙurar tana ƙunshe da crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa. Ku guji shaƙarta.
washed-kaolin-from-the-old-zettlitz-1rbg: Kaolin da aka wanke daga tsofaffin ramukan Zettlitz (Sedlec) kusa da Karlovy Vary, kaolinite fiye da 90%. Ya daɗe shi ne kaolin na ma’auni a ilimin sinadaran ceramics na Jamus, don haka girke-girken da ke neman ''Zettlitzer Kaolin'' suna nufin wannan kaya. Har yanzu ana sayar wa magina don glaze, engobe da porcelain.
kaolin-dust-may-contain-a-little-15eorz7: Ƙurar kaolin; tana iya ƙunsar ɗan crystalline silica (quartz). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
the-plain-kaolin-that-bodmer-ton-hgczzf: ''Kaolin'' na gama gari da Bodmer Ton, babban mai sayar da kayan tukwane na Switzerland, ke sayarwa tare da English china clay ɗinsa. Ya fi ƙwaya-ƙwaya kuma ba shi da laushin aiki kamar Cornish china clay (19% ne kaɗai ya fi microns 2 laushi), kuma yana da ƙarin silica da potash (K2O 2.9%), don haka yana ƙara ɗan flux. Ana amfani da shi don kawo alumina da silica cikin glaze da kuma don farin engobe.
kaolin-dust-german-washed-kaolins-usuall: Ƙurar kaolin; kaolin na Jamus da aka wanke yawanci suna ƙunshe da wani adadin quartz mai laushi. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
the-standard-kaolin-of-carl-ja-4uwzzt: ''Kaolin'' na yau da kullum na Carl Jäger, babban mai sayar da kayan tukwane na Jamus a Westerwald. Carl Jäger ya ce yana fitowa fari sosai bayan gasa, don glaze da jikin yumɓu, kuma yana ƙara taurin da ke hana karcewa, juriya ga sinadarai da kaurin glaze. Bayanan Glazy sun nuna ana sayar da shi a Belgium ma (Argilières Hins), kuma Silica Nordic a Denmark yana sayar da kaolin mai ƙimomi iri ɗaya.
carl-ja-ger-s-safety-data-a594dg: Takardar bayanan aminci ta Carl Jäger (version 5, 30.01.2018) ta ce ba shi da haɗari amma ta lura cewa yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica mai laushi ƙasa da 1%; ku guji tayar da ƙura.
white-firing-breton-porcelain-kaolin-sol: Kaolin na porcelain na Brittany mai fitowa fari bayan gasa, ana sayar wa magina na France da sunan Kaolinor 1C (Ceradel), na Spain kuma da sunan Caolín d''Arvor (Prodesco). Kaolin ne na gama gari mai ɗan tsafta don glaze, engobe da jikin porcelain.
ceradel-s-safety-sheet-dec-2024-ei419a: Takardar bayanan aminci ta Ceradel (Dec 2024) ta ce kaolin 100% ne, ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba; ku ɗauki ƙurarsa kamar kowace ƙurar yumɓu.
the-spanish-national-kaolin-that-spanish: Kaolin ''na ƙasa'' na Spain da shagunan tukwane na Spain (Prodesco, Marphil a Madrid) ke sayarwa don glaze, engobe da jikin yumɓu na babban zafi, sabanin English kaolin da ake shigowa da shi. Yana da ɗan ƙarin silica da ƙarancin potash fiye da kaolin na Cornwall ko Brittany.
kaolin-dust-may-contain-some-fine-14c37u: Ƙurar kaolin; tana iya ƙunsar wani adadin quartz mai laushi. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-light-firing-kaolinitic-westerwald-cla: Yumɓun Westerwald mai kaolinite wanda ke fitowa da launi mai haske bayan gasa (kaolinite 46%, mica 18%, quartz 25%) daga ɗaya daga cikin manyan masu haƙar yumɓu na Jamus, ana sayar da shi a matsayin garin yumɓu da aka niƙa. Bincikensa da laushinsa suna kusa da na English ball clay kamar TWVA (kusan alumina 28%, LOI 11.6%), don haka zai iya maye gurbinsa a glaze da engobe.
contains-crystalline-silica-about-25-qua: Yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (kusan quartz 25% bisa binciken ma’adinai na mai yin sa); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-german-westerwald-ball-clay-that-f3nfk: Ball clay na Jamus (Westerwald) da Sibelco ke lissafawa don glaze da engobe: mai laushi sosai (69% ƙasa da microns 2), yana fitowa da launi mai haske, mai kusan alumina 24% da potash 2.8%. Bincikensa yana kusa da na English HVAR ball clay.
ball-clays-contain-free-quartz-avoid-hho: Ball clay yana ƙunshe da free quartz; ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-potassium-sodium-borosilicate-frit-wit: Potassium-sodium borosilicate frit mai alkali mai yawa, daga kayan Vibrantz na Frankfurt. Shi ne frit na Jamus da aka saba don raku da sauran glaze na alkaline na ƙaramin zafi. Faɗaɗawa 150 x 10^-7/K (20-400 °C); yana fara laushi a 645 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point (siffar rabin ƙwallo) a 740 °C.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-16pz22p: Frit marar darma (lead) (gilashi, CAS 65997-18-4). Ba a samu SDS na wannan kaya ba. Frit marasa darma masu kama da shi daga Mondré & Manz da Reimbold & Strick ba a sanya su cikin rukunin haɗari ba a SDS ɗinsu. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-no-wufbi: Sodium borosilicate frit marar alumina. Flux ne mai ƙarfi na ƙaramin zafi kuma tushen boron. BSZ yana sayar da shi don glaze na alkaline marasa darma (lead), musamman raku, kuma yana bayyana a girke-girken crystalline glaze. Faɗaɗawa 85 x 10^-7/K; yana fara laushi a 685 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point a 780 °C.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-g5r9m7: Frit marar darma (lead) (gilashi, CAS 65997-18-4) mai boron mai yawa. Ba a samu SDS na wannan kaya ba. Wasu masu sayarwa na EU suna sa wa frit masu yawan boron alamar mai guba ga haihuwa (H360FD), don haka ku duba SDS da ke zuwa tare da buhun. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-calcium-potassium-borosilicate-frit-so: Calcium-potassium borosilicate frit da ake sayarwa a matsayin ''Basisfritte'' (frit na tushe). Da kusan alumina 12%, sinadaransa suna kusa da cikakken glaze kuma ya dace da tushen glaze mai haske na earthenware da ƙananan stoneware. Faɗaɗawa ƙarami ne, 56 x 10^-7/K; yana fara laushi a 865 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point a 1050 °C.
a-calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-little-: Calcium borosilicate frit mai ƙarancin boron da kusan alumina 12%. Babban zafin narkewarsa yana sa ya dace da stoneware da glaze na earthenware da ake gasawa a zafi mafi girma. Faɗaɗawa 76 x 10^-7/K; yana fara laushi a 830 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point a kusan 1080 °C. Hans Wolbring, keramikbedarf-online.de da Lehmhuus (Switzerland) ke sayarwa.
a-zinc-barium-silicate-frit-with-gmr2om: Zinc-barium silicate frit marar boron, ana amfani da shi don glaze na satin-matte da marar sheƙi, kuma a matsayin hanya mafi ƙarancin narkewa ta ƙara barium da zinc. Faɗaɗawa kusan 103-105 x 10^-7/K; yana fara laushi a 835 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point a 990 °C. BSZ, Hans Wolbring da keramikbedarf-online.de ke sayarwa.
leadless-but-it-contains-about-35-ok0uml: Marar darma (lead), amma yana ƙunshe da kusan barium oxide 35% da zinc oxide 19% da aka ɗaure a cikin gilashi. Ba a samu SDS ba. Barium a cikin frit ya fi barium carbonate wuyar narkewa sosai, amma ku gwada kowane glaze mai barium don zubar ƙarfe (leaching) kafin a yi amfani da shi a fuskokin da ke taɓa abinci. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-low-expansion-sodium-borosilicate-frit: Sodium borosilicate frit mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa: mai yawan silica da boron, mai ƙarancin alkali. Ana ƙara frit masu ƙaramin faɗaɗawa irin wannan a glaze don rage faɗaɗawarsu saboda zafi da magance crazing. Shi kaɗai yana narkewa ne a babban zafi kawai (half-sphere point 1270 °C). Faɗaɗawa 48 x 10^-7/K. Hans Wolbring da keramikbedarf-online.de ke sayarwa.
a-calcium-alkali-borosilicate-frit-with-: Calcium-alkali borosilicate frit mai kusan alumina 11%, ana sayar da shi a matsayin ''Alkaliborfritte''. keramikbedarf-online.de yana sayar da shi don layin kariya a naked raku kuma a matsayin flux a glaze na aventurine. Faɗaɗawa 65 x 10^-7/K; yana fara laushi a 830 °C kuma yana kai half-sphere point a 970 °C.
a-soda-potash-lime-frit-with-52qvc2: Soda-potash-lime frit marar boron kuma kusan marar alumina. Faɗaɗawarsa tana da girma sosai: 141 x 10^-7/K, tare da fara laushi a 503 °C. Ana amfani da shi don raku, crackle da crystalline glaze, da kuma shuɗi da turquoise masu ƙarfi na alkaline. Carl Jäger, BSZ, Keramik-Kraft, Hans Wolbring, Rantzauer Töpferbedarf da Ing. Lehrer (Austria) ke sayarwa.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-1h3mmym: Frit marar darma (lead) (gilashi, CAS 65997-18-4). SDS da Carl Jäger ya bayar don wannan frit na Mondré & Manz ya ce ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba a ƙarƙashin CLP. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-zinc-alkali-borosilicate-frit-rich-1ia: Zinc alkali borosilicate frit mai yawan potash da babban faɗaɗawa: 108 x 10^-7/K, yana fara laushi a 582 °C. Ana sayar da shi don glaze marar sheƙi, satin da crackle, da kuma don ɗaga faɗaɗawar glaze. Carl Jäger, BSZ da Rantzauer Töpferbedarf ke sayarwa.
a-leadless-alkali-frit-containing-lithiu: Alkali frit marar darma (lead) mai ɗauke da lithium, zinc da calcium. Masu sayarwa sun ce frit ne mai sheƙi, wanda boron ke sa ya zama mai hana haske ratsawa (opacified), mai babban ƙarfin fuska (surface tension), don glaze mai haske, fari da na kayatarwa. Faɗaɗawa 65.9 x 10^-7/K, tare da fara laushi a 680 °C. Carl Jäger, BSZ da Rantzauer Töpferbedarf ke sayarwa.
a-leadless-borosilicate-frit-opacified-w: Borosilicate frit marar darma (lead) da zircon ke sa ya zama mai hana haske ratsawa (ZrO2 7.5%), don farin glaze. An ƙirƙira shi don tayil ɗin bango na earthenware da ake gasawa da sauri. Faɗaɗawa 63 x 10^-7/K, tare da fara laushi a 690 °C. Carl Jäger da Rantzauer Töpferbedarf ke sayarwa.
a-leadless-sodium-borosilicate-frit-sold: Sodium borosilicate frit marar darma (lead) da ake sayarwa don glaze na raku. Masu sayarwa suna kuma ba da shawararsa don celadon da, tare da ƙarin iron oxide, don glaze na aventurine. Faɗaɗawa 72.8 x 10^-7/K (20-400 °C), tare da fara laushi a 565 °C. Keramik-Kraft da Rantzauer Töpferbedarf ke sayarwa.
a-calcium-borate-frit-with-very-cmvn8f: Calcium borate frit mai ƙarancin silica sosai, ana amfani da shi a matsayin tushen boron da calcium mai yawa. Masu sayarwa na Jamus suna sayar da shi a matsayin madadin colemanite da Portabor wanda ke guje wa yadda suke sa ruwan glaze ya yi kauri da yadda suke fyace a cikin kiln. Faɗaɗawa 76.2 x 10^-7/K, tare da fara laushi a 670 °C. keramikbedarf-online.de da Rantzauer Töpferbedarf ke sayarwa.
a-barium-zinc-frit-that-contains-5y8sr8: Barium-zinc frit mai ɗauke da lead oxide 11% (darma, Pb); mai yin sa ya lissafa shi a cikin frit ɗinsa na darma. contains-lead-pbo-about-11-and-1wywyyz: YANA ƊAUKE DA DARMA (LEAD, Pb) (PbO kusan 11%) da barium (BaO kusan 38%). a-low-expansion-calcium-borosilicate-fri: Calcium borosilicate frit mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa: faɗaɗawa 42 x 10^-7/K, transformation 650 °C, fara laushi 710 °C. Boron ɗinsa ya yi ƙasa sosai, silica ɗinsa kuma ya fi yawa sosai, fiye da ainihin calcium borate frit.
leadless-frit-cas-65997-18-4-s12mq5: Frit marar darma (lead) (CAS 65997-18-4). SDS na Reimbold & Strick da aka gani don wani frit marar darma mai kama da shi (A 3249 P, 2017) bai sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-calcium-borate-frit-with-one-awae2q: Calcium borate frit mai CaO ɗaya zuwa B2O3 ɗaya, babu silica ko alumina; girke-girken Holland suna kiransa ''calciumboraatfritte 3221''. Tushen boron ne mai yawa, a sinadarai kamar colemanite ba tare da ruwa ba. Keramikos, Cock Keramiek, Ve-Ka da De Beeldhouwwinkel ke sayarwa.
leadless-keramikos-and-ve-ka-state-ngetf: Marar darma (lead). Keramikos da Ve-Ka sun ce ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba a ƙarƙashin CLP. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-zinc-borosilicate-frit-with-no-ua13zq: Zinc borosilicate frit marar alumina mai kusan ZnO 29%. Girke-girken Holland suna amfani da shi don ƙara zinc a siffar frit, don glaze marar sheƙi, crystalline da launukan da suka dogara da zinc. Keramikos da Cock Keramiek ke sayarwa.
leadless-keramikos-and-cock-keramiek-sta: Marar darma (lead). Keramikos da Cock Keramiek sun ce ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-sodium-zinc-alkali-frit-with-o6mq1u: Sodium-zinc alkali frit marar boron mai ƙarancin alumina: tsohon ''alkalifritte 1510'' na Holland don glaze na alkaline kamar shuɗin turquoise na copper, raku da crackle. leadless-keramikos-states-that-it-is-6gm: Marar darma (lead). Keramikos ya ce ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba a ƙarƙashin CLP. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
standard-lead-bisilicate-frit-pbo-2sio2-: Lead bisilicate frit na yau da kullum, na darma (lead, Pb) (PbO·2SiO2 tare da ɗan alumina), don glaze na earthenware da majolica na ƙaramin zafi; shi ne takwaran Holland na lead bisilicate na UK. Cock Keramiek, Ve-Ka (da sunan 3647) da De Beeldhouwwinkel (Keramikos 10.05) ke sayarwa.
contains-lead-pbo-about-65-cock-7wgj88: YANA ƊAUKE DA DARMA (LEAD, Pb) (PbO kusan 65%). Cock Keramiek ya sa masa alamar ''Gevaarlijke stof'' (abu mai haɗari). Ku gwada kowane glaze da aka yi da shi a ɗakin gwaji don sakin darma (Pb) kafin a yi amfani da shi a fuskokin da ke taɓa abinci ko abin sha.
lead-monosilicate-frit-one-pbo-to-yl6thf: Lead monosilicate frit na darma (lead, Pb) (PbO ɗaya zuwa SiO2 ɗaya), frit na yau da kullum mafi yawan darma. Ve-Ka (Netherlands, da sunan 2994) ke sayar wa magina. Ing. Lehrer (Austria) ya wallafa SDS na 2019 na R&S A 1316 P.
contains-lead-pbo-about-79-reimbold-t25l: YANA ƊAUKE DA DARMA (LEAD, Pb) (PbO kusan 79%). water-washed-primary-kaolin-from-pittong: Primary kaolin da aka wanke da ruwa daga Pittong kusa da Ballarat, masana’antar hydrous kaolin guda ɗaya tilo ta Australia; china clay na Australia da aka saba don glaze da farin jikin yumɓu. Walker Ceramics (BA330), Pottery Supplies Online, The Potter''s Market da wasu ke sayarwa.
sds-suvo-minerals-australia-eckalite-1-1: SDS (Suvo Minerals Australia, Eckalite 1 & 1 Plus, 2024): kaolin >98%, crystalline silica (quartz) <1%. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-second-pittong-kaolin-grade-slightly-1: Nau’i na biyu na kaolin na Pittong, mai ɗan ƙarin iron fiye da Eckalite 1; Walker Ceramics (BA331, wanda ya maye gurbin Eckaglas ɗinsu), Northcote Pottery Supplies da Blackwattle Pottery ke sayar wa magina. Ana amfani da shi don alumina na glaze, riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa, da slip. Ƙimomin Walker su ne waɗanda ya bayar a 2007 don Eckaglas, nau’in da wannan ya maye gurbinsa.
kaolin-the-related-eckalite-1-sds-57l3rd: Kaolin; SDS na Eckalite 1 mai alaƙa (2024) ya ce quartz <1%. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
very-white-low-iron-low-titania-1uwzzja: Halloysite fari sosai mai ƙarancin iron da titania (yumɓu na rukunin kaolin) da aka raba daga rhyolite da ya sauya a Matauri Bay; ana amfani da shi don porcelain mai bayyana haske da glaze masu haske sosai. Walker Ceramics (BA139) ke sayarwa a Australia, a Amurka kuma da sunan ''Kaolin New Zealand''.
kaolin-group-clay-with-fine-tubular-1t37: Yumɓu na rukunin kaolin mai ƙananan ƙwayoyi masu siffar bututu; dutsen asalinsa quartz ne da cristobalite kuma ɗan kaɗan nasu na iya kasancewa a ciki (XRD na ƙasidar ya nuna duka biyun). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
dry-milled-very-plastic-secondary-clay-7: Secondary clay mai laushin aiki sosai da aka niƙa a bushe daga ramin Claypro kansa a Axedale, Victoria; ball clay na Australia da ake sayar wa magina da sunan CA1 (Northcote) da CA2 (Walker, Blackwattle). claypro-sds-2015-about-20-crystalline-2r: Claypro SDS (2015): kusan crystalline silica (quartz) 20%; an sanya shi a rukunin Carcinogen Category 1A (H350, ta shaƙa). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-plastic-white-firing-kaolinitic-clay-1: Yumɓu mai kaolinite da laushin aiki wanda ke fitowa fari bayan gasa, mai halayen aiki kamar ball clay, wanda aka yi don maye gurbin tsofaffin Cresta BB da BB4; yana bayyana a tsofaffin girke-girken Australia da sunan ''Clay Ceram''. walker-ceramics-already-listed-it-as-1ni: Walker Ceramics ya riga ya lissafa shi a matsayin wanda ba a samu a Oktoba 2016.
unimin-tds-contains-free-crystalline-sil: Unimin TDS: yana ƙunshe da free crystalline silica (quartz). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-thai-potash-feldspar-of-the-1yw5cs8: Potash feldspar na Thailand, irin wanda yanzu ake sayarwa da sunan ''potash feldspar'' a Australia; Walker Ceramics ya lissafa BA350 ɗinsa a matsayin na Thailand, kuma SDS na Blackwattle ya ambaci ''Potash Feldspar K200BL'' (Scott Chemicals). sds-for-potash-feldspar-k200bl-scott-190: SDS na Potash Feldspar K200BL (Scott Chemicals, 2021): feldspar 90-98%, quartz 2-10%. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
albite-type-soda-feldspar-imported-from-: Soda feldspar irin na albite da ake shigowa da shi daga Indiya, wanda Walker Ceramics da Blackwattle Pottery ke sayarwa; flux mai ƙarin sheƙi kuma mai narkewa a ɗan ƙaramin zafi fiye da potash feldspar, don glaze na stoneware da matsakaicin zafi. Ƙimomin Walker na 2007 ne kuma ba su nuna calcium ba, wanda soda feldspar na Indiya yawanci suke da shi.
walker-msds-2019-soda-feldspar-98-1phdzl: Walker MSDS (2019): soda feldspar >98%, tare da quartz a lissafe a matsayin sashi mai haɗari. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
walker-s-fluorine-free-blend-of-1i67hb4: Haɗin ma’adinai marar fluorine na Walker da aka yi don ya yi daidai da Cornish stone na halitta; Walker ya ce flux ne ɗan mafi rauni fiye da feldspar, don girke-girken da ke neman Cornish stone. Walker ya buga iron oxide 1.5%, wanda yake da yawa ga madadin Cornish stone; ku tambayi Walker kafin ku dogara da shi.
no-sds-reviewed-as-a-feldspar-19nqyax: Ba a duba SDS ba. A matsayin haɗin irin na feldspar da quartz zai ƙunshi crystalline silica; ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
milled-quartz-flour-about-90-finer-lnsq1: Garin quartz da aka niƙa (kusan 90% ya fi microns 45 laushi) daga aikin Sibelco a Lang Lang; ''Silica 200#'' da Walker (BA770), Keane, Northcote da Blackwattle ke sayarwa. SDS na Walker ya ambaci jerin Sibelco WQ.
sibelco-sds-milled-silica-products-2011-: Sibelco SDS (kayan silica da aka niƙa, 2011): quartz 99%, crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa fiye da 20%. Shaƙa na dogon lokaci yana haifar da silicosis (cutar huhu) da ciwon daji na huhu; ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
lead-free-high-soda-high-expansion-4gjtq: Frit marar darma (lead-free), mai yawan soda da babban faɗaɗawa, tare da ɗan boron. Shi ne takwaran Ferro Australia na US Frit 3110, kuma ana ambatonsa a yawancin girke-girken Australia don glaze na turquoise na copper, ruwan hoda-shunayya na manganese da crackle (Walker ya ce 980-1080°C, faɗaɗawa 96 x10^-7). Walker Ceramics yanzu yana kawo US Ferro 3110 da ake shigowa da shi a madadinsa, kuma wasu shaguna har yanzu suna sayarwa da sunan 4110, don haka ku duba wane frit kuke da shi.
walker-ceramics-listed-it-until-february: Walker Ceramics ya lissafa shi har Fabrairu 2020, amma a Maris 2021 ba ya nan.
no-sds-seen-frit-is-a-t89ijb: Ba a ga SDS ba. Frit gilashi ne da aka niƙa wanda babu free crystalline silica a cikinsa; ku guji shaƙar ƙura mai laushi.
lead-free-calcium-borosilicate-frit-ferr: Calcium borosilicate frit marar darma (lead-free), nau’in Ferro Australia na US Frit 3124 amma mai ƙarancin alumina. Tushen da aka saba ne don glaze na earthenware, har da glaze masu haske a kan underglaze, a 1040-1100°C (Walker; faɗaɗawa 74 x10^-7). Masu sayarwa na Australia da NZ yanzu suna sayar da US Ferro 3124 a matsayin madadinsa; 3124 yana da ƙarin alumina, don haka girke-girken da aka rubuta don 4124 na iya buƙatar ɗan ƙarancin kaolin.
soft-lead-free-high-calcium-borosilicate: Borosilicate frit mai laushi, marar darma (lead-free), mai yawan calcium. Shi ne takwaran Ferro Australia na US Frit 3134, tare da ɗan alumina, kuma yana bayyana a yawancin tsofaffin girke-girken earthenware da matsakaicin zafi na Australia. Masu sayarwa yanzu suna sayar da US Ferro 3134 a madadinsa, kuma Walker ya ba da shawarar 3134-2 60% tare da 3124 40% don kwaikwayon 4108.
medium-hard-lead-free-calcium-sodium-1da: Calcium-sodium borosilicate frit mai matsakaicin tauri, marar darma (lead-free), don glaze masu haske. Ferro ya ce glaze na frit ɗin tare da kaolin 10% yana gasuwa a 1050-1100°C (Walker ya ce faɗaɗawa 61 x10^-7). Walker ya ce Ferro ya ba da shawarar US Frit 3124 a matsayin madadi mafi kusa bayan an daina yin 4131.
hard-lead-free-clear-borosilicate-frit-1: Borosilicate frit mai tauri, marar darma (lead-free), mai haske, don earthenware a 1040-1100°C (Walker; faɗaɗawa 69 x10^-7). Ana ambatonsa a tsofaffin girke-girken Australia. Walker ya maye gurbinsa da 4131, wanda shi ma an daina yin sa, don haka US Frit 3124 ne frit mafi kusa da ake sayarwa yanzu.
alumina-free-lead-free-sodium-calcium-4v: Sodium-calcium borosilicate frit marar alumina, marar darma (lead-free), don earthenware a 1040-1100°C (Walker; faɗaɗawa 83 x10^-7). Babu mai sayarwa da ya ambaci madadi. US Frit 3134 ne mafi kusa da ake sayarwa, ko da yake yana da ƙarin calcium da ƙarancin sodium.
standard-low-solubility-lead-bisilicate-: Lead bisilicate frit na yau da kullum mai ƙarancin narkewa, na darma (lead, Pb) (kusan lead oxide 65%), don glaze na earthenware masu haske da sheƙi a 950-1050°C (Walker; faɗaɗawa 72 x10^-7). lead-frit-about-65-lead-oxide-1r8qgke: FRIT NA DARMA (LEAD, Pb): kusan lead oxide 65%, a riƙe cikin gilashi. Mahaɗan darma (Pb) masu guba ne idan an haɗiye ko an shaƙa, za su iya cutar da haihuwa da jaririn da ke ciki, kuma suna lalata gaɓoɓin jiki idan an sha fama da su akai-akai. Ku guji duk wata ƙura, ku sa respirator na P2/P3, ku wanke jiki bayan amfani, kuma ku nisanta shi daga wuraren abinci da yara. Dole glaze da aka yi da shi a tsara shi kuma a gasa shi daidai, kuma ya kamata ɗakin gwaji ya gwada sakin darma (Pb) daga kayan amfani.
dense-lead-free-zircon-opacified-white-1: Farin frit mai nauyi, marar darma (lead-free), da zircon ke sa ya zama mai hana haske ratsawa (kusan ZrO2 12%), don farin glaze da na launuka masu laushi na earthenware a 1040-1100°C (Walker; faɗaɗawa 59 x10^-7). Walker Ceramics yana sayar da Frit 9113 a madadinsa tun 2022 (an lissafa shi na ɗan lokaci a matsayin 9117), amma ba a wallafa binciken 9113 ba.
no-sds-seen-frit-is-a-btjxa5: Ba a ga SDS ba. Frit gilashi ne da aka niƙa wanda babu free crystalline silica a cikinsa. Yana ƙunshe da zirconium da zinc oxides a cikin gilashin. Ku guji shaƙar ƙura mai laushi.
a-leadless-very-low-expansion-calcium-zq: Calcium-barium borosilicate frit marar darma (lead), mai ƙaramin faɗaɗawa sosai (faɗaɗawa 40 x 10^-7/K), mai yawan silica da boron. Ana ƙara frit masu ƙaramin faɗaɗawa haka kaɗan-kaɗan don rage faɗaɗawar glaze da magance crazing. Shi kaɗai yana da tauri (fara laushi 910 °C, half-sphere point 1280 °C). Hans Wolbring (Höhr-Grenzhausen, Germany) ke sayarwa.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-1jelw38: Frit marar darma (lead) (gilashi, CAS 65997-18-4) mai kusan barium oxide 6% da boron oxide 22% da aka ɗaure a cikin gilashin. Ba a samu SDS na wannan kaya ba. Wasu masu sayarwa na EU suna sa wa frit masu yawan boron alamar mai guba ga haihuwa (H360FD), don haka ku duba SDS da ke zuwa tare da buhun. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-leadless-calcium-zinc-borosilicate-fri: Calcium-zinc borosilicate frit marar darma (lead) mai ɗan lithium da barium, ana sayar da shi don glaze na kayatarwa marasa sheƙi zuwa satin-matte. Faɗaɗawa 70 x 10^-7/K; transformation 555 °C, fara laushi 740 °C, half-sphere point 970 °C. BSZ Keramikbedarf (wanda ya ambaci Vibrantz GmbH, Frankfurt, a matsayin mai yin sa) da Hans Wolbring ke sayarwa.
leadless-frit-glass-cas-65997-18-14d0cts: Frit marar darma (lead) (gilashi, CAS 65997-18-4) mai kusan barium oxide 6% da zinc oxide 7% da aka ɗaure a cikin gilashin. Ba a samu SDS na wannan kaya ba. Barium a cikin frit ya fi barium carbonate wuyar narkewa sosai, amma ku gwada kowane glaze mai barium don zubar ƙarfe (leaching) kafin a yi amfani da shi a fuskokin da ke taɓa abinci. Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.

a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-152: Bincike na yau da kullum daga wani mai sayarwa guda a Arita: ku kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-1v4: Bincike na yau da kullum daga wani mai sayarwa guda a Arita: ku kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-1we: Nazari na yau da kullum daga mai sayarwa ɗaya a Arita: kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. historical-potters-made-their-own-by-1uw: Na tarihi: maginan tukwane suna yin nasu ta hanyar ƙona karan shinkafa, kuma ba a sayar da shi a matsayin daidaitaccen kaya. contains-crystalline-silica-and-unwashed: Yana ɗauke da crystalline silica, kuma tokar da ba a wanke ba tana ƙona fata (caustic) idan ta jiƙe; ku sa safar hannu kuma ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
historical-potters-burnt-their-own-wood-: Na tarihi: maginan tukwane suna ƙona itacensu sannan su wanke tokar a ruwa, suna zubar da gawayin da ke yawo, ko kuma su tace ta a bushe, wanda ke riƙe potash da soda masu narkewa a ruwa. wood-ash-is-caustic-and-so-1l63h70: Tokar itace tana ƙona fata (caustic), haka ma ruwan da ake wanke ta da shi: ku sa safar hannu da kariyar ido, kuma ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
historical-a-local-ash-chestnut-prunings: Na tarihi, tokar yanki: rassan bishiyar chestnut da aka yanke aka ƙona a Kasama, Ibaraki, sannan aka wanke ta hanyar jiƙawa a ruwa da canza ruwan duk lokacin da ya lafa. historical-a-porcelain-stone-from-san-1t: Na tarihi: dutsen porcelain (瓷石) daga ƙauyen San Bao kusa da Jingdezhen, China, da aka haƙa a can aka sayar wa masana''antun tukwane a matsayin bulo; ba a sayar da shi a wajen China. Wani, daga littafin koyar da glaze na Jiangxi, ya kusan zama ɗaya, da Al₂O₃ 17.64%, K₂O 4.02% da Na₂O 4.68%, kuma dutse daga San Bao yana bambanta tsakanin masu samarwa da kuma daga shekara zuwa shekara.
historical-a-porcelain-stone-of-the-8xaa: Na tarihi: dutsen porcelain (瓷石) na masana''antun tukwane na Jingdezhen a China; ba a sayar da shi a wajen China. historical-an-iron-rich-local-clay-5r3sj: Na tarihi: yumɓun yanki mai ƙarfe mai yawa (紫金土) daga ƙauyen Gaojitou a Dayao, kusa da kiln na Longquan a China, da ake ƙarawa a cikin yumɓun Longquan saboda ƙarfensa da alumina; ba a sayar da shi a wajen China. Wannan nazari ɗaya ne, wanda takardar ta ɗauko daga binciken China na baya. Yadda aka haƙa shi aka shirya shi ba ya cikin majiyar.
a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-1nq: Nazari na yau da kullum daga mai sayarwa ɗaya a Arita: kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-jxf: Nazari na yau da kullum daga mai sayarwa ɗaya a Arita: kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. Kaolin daga Korea, da ake sayarwa a Japan. Da Fe₂O₃ 1.22% yana da ƙarfe fiye da kaolin masu ƙarancin ƙarfe, don haka ba ya yin fari sosai idan an gasa.
a-typical-analysis-from-one-supplier-1un: Nazari na yau da kullum daga mai sayarwa ɗaya a Arita: kwatanta shi da na mai sayar muku. chromium-iii-oxide-about-99-cr2o3-1xoqx1: Chromium(III) oxide, kusan Cr2O3 99%: mai launin kore mai ƙarfi sosai kuma mai jure zafi (yana narkewa kusan 2435 C / 4415 F). A gasa ta oxidation daga kusan cone 6 zuwa sama ɗan chromium yana zama tururi kuma zai iya shafa ruwan hoda a kan glaze na kusa da tin ke sa su zama masu hana haske ratsawa; tare da zinc yana zama launin ruwan ƙasa.
not-classified-no-signal-word-on-md0bl8: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (babu kalmar gargaɗi) a SDS na Potterycrafts da na Laguna/Huntsman; wasu masu sanarwa na EU suna ƙara H317 (zai iya sa allergy na fata). Yana ƙunshe da ɗan hexavalent chromium (ƙasa da 100 ppm), kuma dumama shi a iska zai iya samar da ɗan ƙari, don haka ku guji shaƙar ƙurar da hayaƙin kiln.
black-cobalt-oxide-mostly-co3o4-sold-o5x: Baƙin cobalt oxide, galibi Co₃O₄, ana sayar da shi a matsayin kusan cobalt 71–73%: a glaze ana ƙidaya shi kusan CoO 92.7%, tare da kusan oxygen 6.3% da yake rasawa yayin gasa (Potterycrafts ya lissafa Co₃O₄ 95%, CoO 4% da NiO 0.9% a matsayin babban ƙazanta). Yana sakin wannan oxygen ya zama CoO a kusan 900–950 C (1650–1740 F) a iska, ƙasa da haka a reduction. Ƙarfinsa kusan ninki 1.6 ne na cobalt carbonate (CoO 93% idan aka kwatanta da 58%). Shuɗi mai ƙarfi sosai: 0.25% yana ba da shuɗi mai haske, 1–1.5% kuma shuɗi mai duhu kusan baƙi.
danger-potterycrafts-sds-h334-may-cause-: Haɗari (Potterycrafts SDS): H334 zai iya sa allergy ko alamun asma idan an shaƙa; H412 yana cutar da halittun ruwa. SDS na Laguna na Amurka ya ƙara H302 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye shi, H317 yana sa allergy na fata, da H351 ana zargin yana haifar da ciwon daji; wasu SDS na EU sun lissafa H350i (zai iya haifar da ciwon daji ta shaƙa). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-pink-purple-basic-cobalt-carbonate-1xj: Basic cobalt carbonate mai ruwan hoda-shunayya mai cobalt 45–47%, don haka kusan CoO 58%; sauran (kusan 42%) yana ƙonewa ya fita a matsayin CO2 da ruwa. Yana bazuwa daidai fiye da cobalt oxide; ku yi amfani da kusan ninki 1.5 na yawansa don samun shuɗi iri ɗaya.
danger-potterycrafts-sds-matching-the-eu: Haɗari (Potterycrafts SDS, daidai da rukunin haɗari na EU na bai ɗaya): H302 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye shi; H332 yana cutarwa idan an shaƙa; H317 zai iya sa allergy na fata; H334 zai iya sa allergy ko alamun asma idan an shaƙa; H341 ana zargin yana haifar da lahani na gado; H350i zai iya haifar da ciwon daji ta shaƙa; H360F zai iya lalata haihuwa; H400/H410 mai guba sosai ga halittun ruwa.
black-copper-oxide-cuo-about-98-1hdqa68: Baƙin copper oxide, CuO, mai tsafta kusan 98% (copper 78–79%). Yana narkewa kusan 1326 C (2419 F), amma a iska yana fara rasa oxygen ya zama Cu₂O daga kusan 1010–1030 C. Flux ne mai ƙarfi kuma mai aiki wanda zai iya sa glaze ya gudana; copper yana ƙara zama tururi sama da kusan 1025 C (1877 F) kuma zai iya shafa kayan da ke kusa, musamman farin glaze na tin. Ya fi carbonate ƙwaya-ƙwaya, don haka zai iya yin ɗigo-ɗigo. Fiye da kusan 5% zai iya ba da fuska baƙa mai kama da ƙarfe wadda ba ta dace da kwanonin abinci ba.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-h400-very-toxi: Gargaɗi (Potterycrafts SDS): H400 mai guba sosai ga halittun ruwa; rukunin haɗari na EU na bai ɗaya shi ne H400 da H410. SDS na Amurka (Laguna, daga Phibro) sun ba da H302 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye shi. Hayaƙin copper daga kiln mai zafi yana haifar da zazzaɓin hayaƙin ƙarfe (metal fume fever); ku fitar da iskar kiln.
basic-copper-carbonate-a-green-powder-sh: Basic copper carbonate, gari kore mai copper 55–57%, don haka kusan CuO 70%; sauran (kusan 30%) yana fita a matsayin CO₂ da ruwa daga kusan 290 C (554 F). Ba ya narkewa. Yana ba da launi mafi daidaito fiye da baƙin copper oxide. Flux ne mai aiki; yana fitar da hayaƙi daga kusan 815 C (1500 F) kuma zai iya shafa kayan da ke kusa, musamman farin glaze na tin.
warning-ceramic-color-chemical-sds-00909: Gargaɗi (Ceramic Color & Chemical SDS 00909-A, 2024-09, ana sayarwa ta The Ceramic Shop): H302 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye shi; H332 yana cutarwa idan an shaƙa; H319 yana sa mummunan ƙaiƙayin ido; H400/H410 mai guba sosai ga halittun ruwa.
a-natural-source-of-iron-and-14y8gh2: Tushen iron da titanium na halitta a glaze.
not-classified-ctm-sds-31-32-7ac3hh: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM SDS 31/32; quartz ƙasa da 0.1%); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
magnetite-fe3o4-also-sold-as-magnetic-1j: Magnetite, Fe₃O₄, ana kuma sayar da shi a matsayin magnetic iron oxide; wasu nau’uka ɗanyen ma’adini ne da aka niƙa mai ɗauke da quartz. Tsofaffin littattafan magina suna lissafa black iron a matsayin FeO, amma ba a sayar da ferrous oxide a matsayin kayan magina. Gram da gram yana ba da iron kusan daidai da red iron oxide. Flux ne mai ƙarfi a reduction. Sau da yawa ya fi red iron oxide ƙwaya-ƙwaya; ku tace shi ko ku niƙa shi a ball mill don guje wa ɗigo-ɗigo.
not-classified-ctm-sds-66-avoid-17wgk3h: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM SDS 66); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-hydrated-form-of-iron-oxide-1pqopi1: Iron oxide mai ɗauke da ruwa (hydrated). Ba ya narkewa a ruwa, ƙwayoyinsa ƙanana ne sosai.
not-classified-ctm-sds-73-synthetic-1e8x: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM SDS 73, yellow iron oxide na roba); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
a-material-with-hydrated-iron-oxide-1kzy: Kaya mai ɗauke da hydrated iron oxide da yumɓu. Wani lokaci ana kiransa limonite (a matsayin ma’adinin iron oxide). Da yawa daga cikinsu suna da manganese.
danger-new-riverside-ochre-sds-natural-1: Haɗari (New Riverside Ochre SDS): ochre na halitta mai quartz 20–29% (mai haifar da ciwon daji, rukuni 1A, ta shaƙa; zai iya haifar da silicosis) da manganese dioxide 1.5–4%; ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
potters-manganese-dioxide-is-ground-ore-: Manganese dioxide na magina ɗanyen ma’adini ne da aka niƙa, yawanci kusan MnO₂ 75% tare da iron oxide, silica da alumina, don haka yana ba da kusan MnO 61% kawai. Yana rasa oxygen mataki-mataki yayin da yake zafi, zuwa Mn₂O₃ a kusan 450–600 C da Mn₃O₄ a kusan 750–1100 C; iskar na iya sa kumfa. Launin ruwan ƙasa, da shunayya a glaze na alkaline; flux ne da zarar ya narke a cikin narkakken glaze. Manganese yana fitar da hayaƙi a babban zafi, don haka ku fitar da iskar kiln.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-also-laguna-pr: Gargaɗi (Potterycrafts SDS; har da Laguna/Prince BrickOx SDS; EU na bai ɗaya): H302 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye shi; H332 yana cutarwa idan an shaƙa. Nau’ukan ɗanyen ma’adini na iya ƙunsar crystalline silica. Manganese yana fitar da hayaƙi a babban zafi, don haka ku fitar da iskar kiln.
green-nickel-oxide-is-stoichiometric-nio: Koren nickel oxide shi ne NiO cikakke (stoichiometric), nickel 78.5%. Ba ya rabuwa ko narkewa a kiln (NiO yana narkewa kusan 1955 C / 3550 F) kuma yana jure zafi, don haka ku yi amfani da kaɗan; yana ba da kore, launin ruwan ƙasa da toka masu dushewa, da shuɗi ko ruwan hoda a wasu tushen glaze.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-1vgqp: Haɗari (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, GHS version 06/15): H317 zai iya sa allergy na fata; H334 zai iya sa allergy ko alamun asma idan an shaƙa; H350 zai iya haifar da ciwon daji (EU: H350i, ta shaƙa); H372 yana lalata huhu idan an daɗe ko an sha shaƙarsa akai-akai; H413 zai iya yin illa mai ɗorewa ga halittun ruwa.
black-nickel-oxide-is-nio-with-kerajy: Baƙin nickel oxide NiO ne mai ɗan ƙarin oxygen (kusan nickel 76.4–77.6%), ba ainihin Ni2O3 ba. Yana rasa wannan oxygen ya zama koren NiO a kusan 600–700 C (1100–1300 F), don haka a glaze yana aiki kamar koren nickel oxide, yana ba da kusan 2% ƙasa da NiO ga kowane gram.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-wakl3: Haɗari (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, GHS version 06/15, wanda ya ambaci nau’ukan calcined black nickel oxide A da F): H317 zai iya sa allergy na fata; H334 zai iya sa allergy ko alamun asma idan an shaƙa; H350 zai iya haifar da ciwon daji (EU: H350i, ta shaƙa); H372 yana lalata huhu idan an daɗe ko an sha shaƙarsa akai-akai; H413 zai iya yin illa mai ɗorewa ga halittun ruwa.
pr6o11-the-dark-brown-form-that-n56z4j: Pr₆O₁₁, siffar mai duhun launin ruwan ƙasa da ake sayarwa. A nan ana ƙidaya shi a matsayin Pr₂O₃, siffar da praseodymium ke ɗauka a glaze; ƙarin oxygen ɗin (3.1%) da danshi har zuwa 1% ana ƙidaya su a matsayin LOI (raguwar nauyi a wuta). Ba ya narkewa a kiln (kusan 2183 C); 931 C da ake yawan ambato na ƙarfen ne. Mai launi ne mai rauni: 5–8% yana ba da kore mai kama da lemun tsami zuwa kore mai rawaya, kuma galibi ana amfani da shi a cikin rawayan stain na zircon-praseodymium.
low-hazard-but-sdss-disagree-fujifilm-d1: Ƙaramin haɗari, amma SDS ba su yarda da juna ba: Fujifilm Wako (2023) ba shi da haɗari a ƙarƙashin GHS; LTS (2023) Gargaɗi, H315, H319, H335 (ƙaiƙayin fata, ido da hanyoyin numfashi). Yawancin masu sanarwa na ECHA ba su sanya praseodymium oxide cikin rukunin haɗari ba.
natural-rutile-milled-for-ceramics-about: Rutile na halitta da aka niƙa don ceramics: kusan TiO2 95% tare da ɗan silica, zircon, vanadium, iron da chromium. Nau’ukan Amurka da UK na yanzu suna da iron oxide ƙasa da 1%, ba 9–10% da ake yawan ɗauka ba. Ana amfani da shi don launuka masu gauraye na ruwan ƙasa mai haske zuwa duhu, hana haske ratsawa (opacity) da girman crystal, kuma tare da cobalt, copper ko iron don launuka masu karyewa.
tam-ceramics-sds-2018-warning-eye-1yrsyy: TAM Ceramics SDS (2018): Gargaɗi, yana sa ƙaiƙayin ido da fata (Category 2; H319, H315); ƙura na iya sa ƙaiƙayin hanyoyin numfashi. Potterycrafts SDS: ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba. An soke sanya garin TiO2 da ake shaƙa a rukunin Carc. 2 na EU (2022, aka tabbatar a 2025).
tio2-added-at-about-2-10-wa6in9: TiO₂. Ana ƙara shi a kusan 2–10% (4% ne na yau da kullum) don launuka masu gauraye, hana haske ratsawa da girman crystal, kuma tare da iron ko cobalt don launuka masu karyewa. Yana kuma cikin jerin kaya a matsayin Titanium Oxide, don girke-girken da ke ƙidaya shi a cikin tushen glaze.
vanadium-pentoxide-v2o5-an-orange-yellow: Vanadium pentoxide, V2O5, gari mai launin lemu-rawaya, mai tsafta kusan 99%. Yana narkewa a 690 C (1274 F) kuma yana aiki a matsayin flux; shi kaɗai yana ba da rawaya zuwa launin ruwan ƙasa masu rauni, tare da tin oxide ko zircon kuma rawaya mafi ƙarfi. Mai guba sosai: ku sa respirator, ku guji ƙura, kuma ku fitar da iskar kiln.
danger-eu-gb-harmonised-classification-h: Haɗari. Rukunin haɗari na bai ɗaya na EU/GB: H301 mai guba ne idan an haɗiye shi, H330 yana kisa idan an shaƙa, H335 ƙaiƙayin hanyoyin numfashi, H341 ana zargin yana haifar da lahani na gado, H350 zai iya haifar da ciwon daji, H361fd ana zargin yana lalata haihuwa ko jaririn da ke ciki, H362 cutarwa ga jariran da ake shayarwa, H372 lalacewar huhu daga fama da shi akai-akai, H411 mai guba ga halittun ruwa. SDS na Amurka sun ba da jerin da ya ɗan yi sauƙi amma har yanzu mai tsanani (H302+H332, H319, H335, H341, H351, H361, H372, H411).
stannic-oxide-sno2-about-99-5-14e5t2w: Stannic oxide, SnO₂, mai tsafta kusan 99.5%. Ba ya narkewa a zafin glaze (yana narkewa kusan 1630 C / 2966 F); yana zama a gauraye a matsayin ƙananan ƙwayoyi, wanda ke sa glaze ya zama mai hana haske ratsawa (opaque): 4–6% yana ba da fari mai ɗan hana haske ratsawa, 8–10% yana hana haske ratsawa gaba ɗaya, da fari mai dumi a majolica na ƙaramin zafi. Ba ya hana haske ratsawa sosai a reduction da a cone 10, inda yake fara narkewa. Yana taimakawa samar da jan copper a reduction; tare da ɗan chrome yana zama ruwan hoda.
not-classified-no-signal-word-on-n0mh1: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (babu kalmar gargaɗi) a SDS na yanzu (Potterycrafts 2025, Laguna 2014). Shaƙar ƙurar na shekaru zai iya haifar da stannosis, cutar huhu wadda ba ta da illa mai tsanani.
zirconium-dioxide-zro2-zirconia-rarely-u: Zirconium dioxide, ZrO₂ (zirconia). Ba kasafai ake amfani da shi ɗanye a glaze ba: yawancin girke-girke suna neman zircon (Zircopax, Superpax), wanda zirconium silicate ne. Ba ya narkewa a ruwa; yana hana haske ratsawa domin yana zama ba a narke ba a zafin glaze, yana sa narkakken glaze ya yi tauri kuma zai iya rage crazing.
not-classified-ati-zirconium-oxide-sds-1: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (ATI zirconium oxide SDS, EU); ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
zirconium-silicate-zrsio4-67-2-zro2-i6z2: Zirconium silicate, ZrSiO₄: ZrO₂ 67.2% da SiO₂ 32.8%. Ana sayar da shi da sunayen Zircopax, Superpax, Excelopax, Ultrox da Zircosil, waɗanda galibi girman ƙwayoyinsu ne ya bambanta. Shi ne mai hana haske ratsawa da aka saba: kusan 4–7% don hana haske ratsawa kaɗan, 8–15% ko fiye don hana haske ratsawa gaba ɗaya; 1–3% galibi yana ƙara taurin glaze. Yana aiki a reduction, ba kamar tin oxide ba. Silica ɗinsa ana ƙidaya shi a cikin glaze.
not-classified-ctm-zirconium-silicate-sd: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (CTM zirconium silicate SDS 29; crystalline silica da ake iya shaƙa ƙasa da 0.01%); yana da ɗan tasirin nukiliya (radioactive) (uranium 285–343 ppm, thorium 116–157 ppm), don haka ku guji shaƙar ƙurar.
synthetic-red-iron-oxide-is-about-1i5e3s: Red iron oxide na roba kusan Fe₂O₃ 99% ne; red iron oxide na halitta (hematite da aka niƙa) sun fi rauni, kusan Fe₂O₃ 76–95% tare da yumɓu, quartz da carbonate. Yana daidaita glaze kuma yana jure zafi a oxidation har zuwa kusan cone 7–8, inda yake fara rasa oxygen ya zama flux; a reduction yana zama FeO da wuri kuma flux ne mai ƙarfi.
synthetic-grade-not-classified-as-hazard: Nau’in roba: ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Potterycrafts SDS P3441, rev 2025-10). Nau’ukan ɗanyen ma’adini na halitta suna da alamar Gargaɗi, H373 (lalacewar huhu daga shaƙa na dogon lokaci) domin suna ƙunshe da quartz da ake iya shaƙa.
wyoming-sodium-bentonite-the-standard-gl: Sodium bentonite na Wyoming, abin riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa da aka saba; 1–3% yana hana glaze kwanciya a ƙasa, amma fiye da haka yana sa ya yi jinkirin bushewa kuma ya fi saurin crawling. Yana ƙara ɗan iron, soda da magnesia.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-qzjuvp: Haɗari: H350 zai iya haifar da ciwon daji (ta shaƙa) kuma H372 yana lalata huhu idan an daɗe ko an sha fama da shi akai-akai, domin yana ƙunshe da crystalline silica (Volclay 325: quartz har zuwa 6%, cristobalite har zuwa 2%). Ku guji shaƙar ƙura.
a-water-washed-white-firing-smectite-11s: Smectite clay da aka wanke da ruwa mai fitowa fari bayan gasa (magnesium aluminium silicate), ana amfani da shi a 1–2% a matsayin abin riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa da ƙara masa tauri, da kuma abin ƙara laushin aiki ga porcelain da sauran jikin yumɓu marasa laushin aiki. Ku jiƙa shi sosai a ruwa kafin ku ƙara sauran kaya. Vanderbilt bai wallafa binciken oxide na nau’in T ba; wannan na VEEGUM na kullum ne, wanda aka ambata a wata takardar mallaka (patent) ta 1964, don haka ku ɗauke shi a matsayin kimanin ƙima. Yana da yawan magnesium (MgO 13.7%), ba kamar sodium bentonite ba.
not-classified-vanderbilt-sds-2023-no-17: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Vanderbilt SDS 2023): babu kalmar gargaɗi. Ku guji shaƙar ƙura; shaƙa na dogon lokaci na iya cutar da huhu.
a-purified-hectorite-magnesium-lithium-s: Hectorite (magnesium-lithium smectite) clay da aka tace, wanda yanzu ake sayarwa da sunan Elementis Bentone MA; yana riƙe glaze a cikin ruwa kuma yana ƙara taurin busasshen shafi ba tare da rage saurin bushewa kamar CMC ba. Ba kamar bentonite ba, yana kawo magnesia, lime da ɗan lithia maimakon alumina da iron.
not-classified-elementis-sds-2016-not-j7: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Elementis SDS 2016): ba abu ne mai haɗari a ƙarƙashin GHS ba. Ku guji shaƙar ƙura.
an-organic-gum-that-binds-and-pg9ere: Gum na halitta (organic) da ke ɗaure busasshen shafin glaze kuma ya ƙara masa tauri, yana rage saurin bushewa kuma yana taimakawa shafa da burushi; yana ƙonewa ya ɓace yayin gasa kuma ba a ƙidaya shi a cikin sinadaran. Ruwansa yana lalacewa, don haka ku yi ƙananan batch (haɗi) ko ku ƙara abin adanawa.
warning-may-form-combustible-dust-concen: Gargaɗi: zai iya samar da tarin ƙura mai kama wuta a iska (OSHA combustible dust). Babu rukunin haɗari ga lafiya.
a-soluble-salt-used-in-tiny-1g4n6wq: Gishiri mai narkewa a ruwa da ake amfani da shi ɗan kaɗan sosai don flocculate (sa kauri) ga ruwan glaze domin ya kasance a gauraye; gyaran aiki ne, ba ainihin sinadarin glaze ba. Galibin nauyinsa ruwa ne da sulfate, waɗanda ke fita yayin gasa.
not-classified-giles-chemical-sds-2020-1: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba (Giles Chemical SDS 2020): ba abu ne mai haɗari a ƙarƙashin GHS ba.
manganese-ii-carbonate-a-pinkish-tan-nrm: Manganese(II) carbonate, gari mai launin ruwan ƙasa mai haske da ɗan ruwan hoda; nau’ukan kasuwa kusan manganese 44% ne (MnCO3 zalla 47.8% ne). Ana ƙidaya shi a matsayin MnO, kusan MnO 57% tare da kusan LOI (raguwar nauyi a wuta) 43% yayin da yake fitar da CO2 daga kusan 200 C; yana ba da launin ruwan ƙasa, da shunayya zuwa launin plum a glaze na alkaline.
danger-h372-causes-damage-to-organs-18gj: Haɗari: H372, yana lalata gaɓoɓin jiki (jijiyoyi) idan an daɗe ko an sha shaƙarsa akai-akai (Laguna SDS, rev. 2014-03; har da sanarwar ECHA da aka fi samu). Ku guji ƙurar kuma ku fitar da iskar kiln.
basic-nickel-carbonate-a-light-green-14r: Basic nickel carbonate, gari kore mai haske da ake sayarwa a kusan nickel 46%. Ana ƙidaya shi a matsayin NiO, kusan NiO 58.5% tare da kusan LOI (raguwar nauyi a wuta) 41.5%; iskar da yake fitarwa na iya sa kumburi a glaze. Yana ba da kore, toka da launin ruwan ƙasa masu dushewa, kuma ana amfani da shi don laushin shuɗin cobalt.
danger-h302-h332-harmful-if-swallowed-1e: Haɗari: H302+H332 yana cutarwa idan an haɗiye ko an shaƙa; H315; H317 yana sa allergy na fata; H334 yana sa allergy na numfashi; H341; H350i zai iya haifar da ciwon daji ta shaƙa; H360 zai iya lalata haihuwa ko jaririn da ke ciki; H372. Rukunin haɗari na EU na bai ɗaya ya ba da H360D (zai iya lalata jaririn da ke ciki) kuma ya ƙara H400/H410 (halittun ruwa). Ku guji duk wata ƙura.
sold-to-potters-as-ground-natural-1ijf67: Ana sayar wa magina a matsayin ɗanyen ma’adinin chromite na halitta da aka niƙa daga Afirka ta Kudu, ba ainihin chromate ba: kusan Cr2O3 46% da FeO 26%, tare da alumina da magnesia. Yana jure zafi sosai; yana ba da toka, launin ruwan ƙasa tare da zinc, ruwan hoda zuwa ja tare da tin, da baƙi tare da cobalt.
not-classified-under-ghs-vibrantz-iron-h: Ba a sanya shi cikin rukunin haɗari ba a ƙarƙashin GHS (Vibrantz ''Iron Chromite Chromox 7901'' SDS, rev. 2023-01, kamar yadda Sounding Stone ke sayarwa; har da Prince Minerals SDS na Laguna). Ku guji shaƙar ƙurar; tsofaffin littattafan magina sun ce mai guba ne sosai.
a-rare-earth-oxide-used-as-1yx4z2x: Rare-earth oxide da ake amfani da shi a matsayin mai hana haske ratsawa na ƙaramin zafi kuma mai launi mai rauni, yana ba da kirim zuwa ruwan ƙasa-rawaya ko lemu, musamman tare da titanium ko rutile.
